constructor-arg.value: select distinct sub.adsh AS accessionNumber, sub.filed as filingDate, sub.cik, sub.name as fundFamily, sub.form AS formType, ctm.symbol AS ticker, ctm.class_id as classId, td.series AS seriesId, td.tag AS disclosureTag, td.value AS disclosureValue, td.footnote as additionalStrategyNarrative
from sec_financials.submissions sub join sec_financials.text_disclosures td on sub.adsh = td.adsh join sec_financials.company_tickers_mf ctm on ctm.series_id = td.series and ctm.is_active = true
where td.tag IN(:tags) AND sub.filed >= :minDate AND sub.filed <= :maxDate

INSERT INTO analytics.benchmark_master ( benchmark_name, benchmark_provider, benchmark_type, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at, accession_number ) VALUES ( :benchmarkName, :benchmarkProvider, :benchmarkType, :createdBy, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL, :accessionNumber ) ON CONFLICT (benchmark_name) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = :updatedBy

INSERT INTO analytics.fund_master ( series_id, cik, fund_name, fund_family, primary_ticker, investment_objective, strategy_narrative, strategy_type, benchmark_id, benchmark_name, accession_number, reporting_cadence, has_daily_pricing, has_quarterly_holdings, created_by, updated_by, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :seriesId, :cik, :fundName, :fundFamily, :primaryTicker, :investmentObjective, :strategyNarrative, :strategyType, :benchmarkId, :benchmarkName, :accessionNumber, :reportingCadence, :hasDailyPricing, :hasQuarterlyHoldings, :createdBy, NULL, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL ) ON CONFLICT (series_id) DO UPDATE SET cik = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cik, analytics.fund_master.cik), fund_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fund_name, analytics.fund_master.fund_name), fund_family = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.fund_family, analytics.fund_master.fund_family), primary_ticker = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.primary_ticker, analytics.fund_master.primary_ticker), investment_objective = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.investment_objective, analytics.fund_master.investment_objective), strategy_narrative = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.strategy_narrative, analytics.fund_master.strategy_narrative), strategy_type = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.strategy_type, analytics.fund_master.strategy_type), benchmark_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.benchmark_id, analytics.fund_master.benchmark_id), benchmark_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.benchmark_name, analytics.fund_master.benchmark_name), accession_number = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.accession_number, analytics.fund_master.accession_number), reporting_cadence = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.reporting_cadence, analytics.fund_master.reporting_cadence), has_daily_pricing = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.has_daily_pricing, analytics.fund_master.has_daily_pricing), has_quarterly_holdings = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.has_quarterly_holdings, analytics.fund_master.has_quarterly_holdings), updated_by = :updatedBy, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

INSERT INTO analytics.fund_benchmark_association ( series_id, benchmark_id, benchmark_name, is_primary, accession_number, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( :seriesId, :benchmarkId, :benchmarkName, :isPrimary, :accessionNumber, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (series_id, benchmark_id) DO UPDATE SET benchmark_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.benchmark_name, analytics.fund_benchmark_association.benchmark_name), is_primary = EXCLUDED.is_primary, accession_number = EXCLUDED.accession_number, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

select rule_id as ruleId, rule_name as ruleName, pattern, is_regex as isRegex, target_strategy as targetStrategy, priority, is_active as isActive from analytics.compliance_rules where is_active = true order by priority;

SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pl.terse), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.std), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.verbose), ''), nf.measure ) AS benchmarkName, nf.adsh AS accessionNumber FROM sec_financials.numeric_facts nf LEFT JOIN sec_financials.presentation_labels pl ON nf.adsh = pl.adsh AND ( pl.tag = nf.measure OR pl.tag = CONCAT(nf.measure, 'Member') ) WHERE nf.tag IN (:benchmarkTags) AND (nf.class IS NULL OR TRIM(nf.class) = '') AND nf.measure IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(nf.measure) NOT IN (:excludedBenchmarks);

SELECT benchmark_id AS benchmarkId, benchmark_name AS benchmarkName, benchmark_provider AS benchmarkProvider, benchmark_type AS benchmarkType FROM analytics.benchmark_master WHERE accession_number IN(:accessionNumbers)

SELECT benchmark_id AS benchmarkId, benchmark_name AS benchmarkName, benchmark_provider AS benchmarkProvider, benchmark_type AS benchmarkType, accession_number AS accessionNumber FROM analytics.benchmark_master WHERE accession_number IS NOT NULL ORDER BY accession_number, benchmark_name

SELECT rule_id as ruleId, pattern, provider_name as providerName, default_type as defaultType, priority FROM analytics.benchmark_provider_rules WHERE is_active = TRUE ORDER BY priority ASC, LENGTH(pattern) DESC

select fm.series_id as seriesId, fm.cik as cik, fm.fund_name as fundName, fm.fund_family as fundFamily, fm.primary_ticker as primaryTicker, fm.investment_objective as investmentObjective, fm.strategy_narrative as strategyNarrative, fm.strategy_type as strategyType, bm.benchmark_id as benchmarkId, bm.benchmark_name as benchmarkName from analytics.fund_master fm join analytics.benchmark_master bm on fm.benchmark_id = bm.benchmark_id where fm.series_id = :seriesId

SELECT DISTINCT td.series AS seriesId, COALESCE( NULLIF(TRIM(pl.terse), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.std), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(pl.verbose), '') ) AS fundName FROM sec_financials.text_disclosures td JOIN sec_financials.presentation_labels pl ON td.adsh = pl.adsh AND pl.tag LIKE CONCAT('%', td.series, '%') WHERE td.tag = :tag AND td.series IS NOT NULL AND COALESCE(pl.terse, pl.std, pl.verbose) IS NOT NULL;

INSERT INTO analytics.reporting_quarter ( filing_year, quarter, is_active, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( :year, :quarter, TRUE, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, :createdBy ) ON CONFLICT (filing_year, quarter) DO UPDATE SET updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = :createdBy RETURNING quarter_id;

INSERT INTO analytics.quarter_fund_association ( quarter_id, series_id, accession_number, created_at, created_by ) VALUES ( :quarterId, :seriesId, :accessionNumber, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, :createdBy ) ON CONFLICT (quarter_id, series_id) DO UPDATE SET accession_number = EXCLUDED.accession_number;
